rows.consumer_context: Index2 appears for Brush only, not Watercolor/Eraser/Line. PaintCanvas.stroke creates repeated diagonal short segments with quarter-width strokes to form a slanted/chisel-like brush mark. Not a font picker, text entry or automatic handwriting conversion.
rows.rationale: Original descriptive phrase: diagonal/slanted stroke. LibreOffice STR_ObjNameSingulLINE_Diag supports ሰያፍ; Android pointer_stroke_style supports ጭረት as graphical stroke. Targets Brush-only repeated short slanted chisel marks, not font choice. No exact primary Calligraphy brush translation established.
rows.limitations: Descriptive paraphrase, NOT an established translation for calligraphy. Native review must check whether singular stroke adequately names repeated short diagonal marks and whether calligraphic/chisel character is preserved. Do not treat this row as release-ready.

rows.rationale: Original border-only phrase. Primary LO Border → ድንበር; only → ብቻ is visible in LO page layout labels. Captures foreground border without fill. Avoids copying text-character Outline → ረቂቅ out of its context.

rows.consumer_context: Index1 shapeStyle fills path interior with foreground color and omits outline. Conventional uniform fill style, not separate flood-fill tool, pattern fill or an implementation guarantee about output alpha beyond inspected canvas behavior.
rows.rationale: Original fill-only paraphrase emphasizes implemented absence of outline. LO graphics sidebar Fill → መሙያ; only → ብቻ. This does not claim Solid literally means only. Foreground fill is implicit in the control context.
rows.limitations: Confirm intentional behavior-based paraphrase and clarity of foreground-only fill; no exact full-phrase primary attestation.
rows.alternative_note: Lexically nearer solid fill (LO Solid → ሙሉ) but does not explicitly distinguish no-outline behavior. Native reviewer should compare candidates.
rows.author_precision_hold: Author adds explicit HOLD beyond lexical suggestion: fill only substitutes an implemented behavior distinction for solid/uniform fill semantics. This must be independently adjudicated, not silently treated as equivalent English or a source correction. Alternative full-fill phrase is also unaccepted; lexical Solid in a transparency context does not establish exact shape-fill terminology.

rows.consumer_context: Index2 shapeStyle fills interior with background color then draws foreground border. Plus sign joins two simultaneous style components; not a single line drawing tool, arithmetic or a request to fill a line. Preserve + separator.
rows.rationale: LO graphics Fill and Line supply both nouns. Literal ASCII + preserved with spaces. In application context this is background fill plus foreground border, NOT the same foreground-only fill as style1.
rows.limitations: Short phrase does not encode color roles, just as English does not; native reviewer must inspect swatches/preview and contrast all three styles.
